findings.observation: Exclusion is over-broad. It drops WorkItemStateTransitionMapper (namespace Lighthouse.Backend.Modules.TrackerIntegration.Domain) from TheConnectors, though it was in scope pre-move. Rules affected: ConnectorsNeverUseStoredFeatures (line 728), EveryTrackerThatReadsParents_AsksTheSelector (lines 641, 646), ReachesAConnector target check (line 628). ParentSourceSelector needs exclusion: its Choose takes StoredFeatures by design. WorkItemStateTransitionMapper uses only WorkItemStateTransition and IWorkItemQueryOwner, so it passes today. A future StoredFeatures or ParentSources read in it would pass silently.
findings.remediation: Narrow the lookahead to ParentSourceSelector only, leaving WorkItemStateTransitionMapper and other Domain types in TheConnectors as before. Re-run DependencySingleDecisionArchUnitTest; all rules stay green.
